title: FATe of Bots: Ethical Considerations of Social Bot Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the classification accuracy of a multilingual bot detection algorithm (BotBuster) across multiple datasets, explicitly comparing the performance on users who tweet primarily in English versus users who tweet primarily in non-English languages.

Conducting a literature survey of 51 bot detection algorithms to calculate descriptive statistics on the distributions of targeted social media platforms, event topics, and languages, demonstrating a heavy skew toward Twitter/X, English texts, and political/health events.
